laws.rule: Since 2 February 2026, non-residents pay EUR 2 to enter the inner area around the Trevi Fountain in Rome. Entry is free for Rome residents, under-6s, people with disabilities and a companion, and MIC Card holders. Buy online or at Tourist Info Points; payment at the site is by card only.

sites.name: Etruscan Necropolises of Cerveteri (Banditaccia) and Tarquinia (Monterozzi)
sites.what: Two Etruscan cemeteries north of Rome: Cerveteri's tumulus tombs and Tarquinia's painted tombs (UNESCO World Heritage).

access.opening: Tuesday to Sunday, closed Mondays. 25 October 2026 to 27 March 2027: 9 am to 5 pm, last entry 4 pm; from 29 March to 12 October 2026 the park listed 9 am to 7.30 pm.
access.tickets: One city's museum and necropolis EUR 13 (about AUD 21, RBA rate 30 October 2026), valid 30 days; all four park sites EUR 21 (about AUD 33, RBA rate 30 October 2026), valid four months. Under 18s free; EU citizens aged 18 to 25 pay EUR 2. Free on the Ministry's free Sundays.
access.closures: The Banditaccia and Monterozzi areas may close on weather-alert days; the park advises phoning 06 9940001 (Banditaccia) or 0766 856308 (Monterozzi) first.
